scope: New benchmark implementation outside the original frozen source census; no extra original-file credit.

claims.claim: For admitted canonical rational4x4 coefficient artifacts, acceptance is equivalent to equality with the public Pauli-derived J,Delta,K coefficient matrices. By linearity this proves the affine matrix identity for every real parameter triple; evaluating coordinate triples proves the converse.
dependencies: The supplied Hamiltonian, fixed basis order and Pauli convention are admitted task data.
Fraction arithmetic and the reviewed tensor indexing implement exact complex rational operations.
limitations: No spectrum, time-evolution, entanglement, thermal or prose-answer certificate.
Independent sampled vector-action checks support implementation validation; linearity, not those samples, supports the all-parameter implication.

claims.claim: The checked workflow admits synthesis only after an accepted representation, allows at most one correction, and preserves no final answer when representation checks fail. Its ungated and deterministic-host controls supply byte-identical solver requests for identical valid matrix context.
dependencies: All paid calls pass through the existing guarded provider and shared run ledger.
The loaded implementation source pins and fixed seed commitment remain valid.
limitations: A solver may ignore or misuse the correct representation.
This is a finite orchestration contract, not a proof of native operadic composition or semantic closure of final answers.
Provider tariff/token enforcement remains an external monetary premise.
